gloss: hand clapping, clapping to a beat

definitions.gloss: hand clapping, clapping to a rhythm or beat
definitions.explanation: Rhythmic clapping of hands, typically done in unison by an audience or group to accompany music, cheering, or traditional celebrations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手拍子|てびょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: The audience clapped along to the beat.

examples.japanese: {手拍子|てびょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{歌|うた}った→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
examples.english: We sang along with the hand clapping.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手拍子|てびょうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the concert, the entire venue got fired up with rhythmic clapping.

notes:
{手拍子|てびょうし} is rhythmic hand clapping, typically done in unison by a group or audience. Composed of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{拍子|ひょうし}→拍子：10495_hyoushi⟧ (rhythm, beat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手拍子|てびょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to clap along to a beat
- {手拍子|てびょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to match the clapping rhythm
- {手拍子|てびょうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧: to get excited with rhythmic clapping
- {手拍子|てびょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send clapping (in support)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Common at concerts, festivals, and traditional celebrations. In Japanese business and celebration culture, {三本締|さんぼんじ}め (three sets of rhythmic claps) and {一本締|いっぽんじ}め (one set) are formal clapping patterns performed at the end of events to mark a successful conclusion.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧: applause (clapping to show appreciation)
- ⟦{拍子|ひょうし}→拍子：10495_hyoushi⟧: rhythm, beat
